fields.title: Derive the SLO
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each scenario, answer three questions and propose an SLO.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: Placing an order in a food delivery service
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Browsing an article archive in media
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Sending a payment in a bank
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/3: Uploading an avatar in a social network
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — goes to a competitor, visits often, low visibility threshold: 99.9%. 2 — waits or returns later, visits rarely: 99% is enough. 3 — money, trust, irreplaceable: maximum, 99.95%+, and RPO ≈ 0 separately. 4 — user will retry themselves, high visibility threshold: 99%. Technique: what do they do on failure, how often do they visit, will they even notice.
